title: Wine & Jazz Series: Presented by The Melody Room
seo_title: Wine & Jazz Series with Laura French in Springfield, MO
description: Wine & Jazz Series is an evening of live jazz and wine at The Gallery at the Gillioz, presented by The Melody Room and featuring jazz vocalist Laura French. Your first glass is provided, and the event is for ages 21 and up with general admission tickets; no outside food or drink is permitted. It takes place Friday, December 18, 2026 at 8:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
